column10: For F1 25, tire wear has been increased at every single circuit to open up race strategy. This makes the one-stopper much more difficult to do (even at the "easier" tracks for it like Las Vegas or Suzuka). It's completely normal and often faster to end races with the tires nearing puncture range (anything above 80%)
Why are the wings so low?

Wings in general run low on F1 25 to allow for overtaking and ERS recharge, and in qualifying, the lower wing allows you to use overtake mode for a little while longer. Dirty air has made overtaking very difficult on F1 25 - particularly in competitive online races. However, some tracks (Monaco) will remain what they are.
I can't make the tires last...

For improved tire wear, try being less aggressive through long corners, mostly via steering input and apex speed. The infamous flick of old has gone in races (save for select corners of select tracks) - making an one-stopper this year requires some seriously good tire saving
